newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Dec 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Dec 27.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following major business stories on Dec. 27:
WASHINGTON - Striking Teamster drivers, seeking to step up pressure on Giant Foods Inc., will extend their picket lines to outside suppliers hired by the supermarket chain.
WASHINGTON - The federal government formally adopted technical standards for a new generation of sharper, more versatile television that the industry hopes will become a fixture in living rooms.
WASHINGTON - Litton Industries Inc. filed a formal protest against the Navy's recent award of a contract to two competitors for a new model of a Marine Corps amphibious ship.
WASHINGTON - Liquor companies find smaller television and radio stations more willing to air commercials for their "hard" products such as whiskey.

JIADING, China - In a remarkable transfer of wealth and technology, Taiwan has become the rich uncle of southern China, opening factories, training workers and helping turn scores of poor communities into boom zones.
